display.purpose: Page titles and high-level section headers.

body.purpose: The workhorse font for all primary content.

shadows.name: ambient-lift
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift for cards and inputs at rest.

shadows.name: active-lift
shadows.purpose: Pronounced lift for modals and active dropdowns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action trigger, evoking growth and energy.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.508 0.118 165.612); color: oklch(0.979 0.021 166.113); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease-standard; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.45 0.12 165); transform: scale(1.02); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease-standard; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375); }

components.name: Standard Input
components.description: Refined field for data entry with explicit focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: white; color: oklch(0.141 0.005 285.823); border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: all 0.2s ease-standard; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.508 0.118 165.612); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.508 0.118 165.612 / 0.2); }

components.name: Data Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: white; border: 1px solid oklch(0.92 0.004 286.32); border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }

narrative.overview: The Vanguard Archive is a digital manifestation of youthful idealism meeting professional execution. It rejects the sterile, rigid nature of traditional administrative tools in favor of a high-velocity, high-clarity environment.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Vanguard Green is the sole high-chroma accent. Its usage is focused on intent; when a user sees Green, they know it is the primary path forward.

rules.name: The Response Rule
rules.body: Shadows are not decorative; they are functional. A shadow always indicates that an element is now 'above' the main archive and ready for interaction.

dos: Do use a high-contrast ratio for all text
Do implement inline editing and keyboard shortcuts for data-heavy tables
Do provide a tooltip for every non-obvious label or action
Do use the Mono font for IDs, NIKs, and status codes
donts: Don't use side-stripe borders as colored accents
Don't use modals as the first thought for data entry
